visualCharacteristics.purpose: TAP Air Portugal's booking box: book, check-in, manage booking and flight status tabs, handed off to TAP's booking engine in a new tab
traits: a pill tab track above a white card with 24px corners
green round radios, fields with a bottom line and code chips
an electric green Search pill, a two-month range calendar without prices

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, key | value, every row optional but Format: Format, Market, Language, Default origin, Default origin name, Airports (link), Tabs, Flight status page, Login page, Corporate link (links), then the label rows by TAP's key or English text

usage: TAP roots' homepages, in the section after the hero (ema-cashub's step; no page uses it yet)
reuseGuidance: Format tap only; labels and links per root. The hand-off, passenger rules and matching are in tap-format.js and airport-match.js; another engine would be another Format.
